dict.string: Sentinel Terminal requires Bluetooth access to turn on/off and connect to your Bluetooth devices on your behalf.
Sentinel Terminal saves a workflow (.flow) file to your Desktop when you choose that place, and runs commands you approve in folders you open.
Sentinel Terminal saves a workflow (.flow) file to Documents when you choose that place, and runs commands you approve in folders you open.
Sentinel Terminal works with files in Downloads when you ask it to (for example "find the zip in Downloads").
